title: ClientIdentity
description: Legacy attribution record for one client of the Task Access Layer. Stored as JSON files under <workspace>/identities/<id>.json and loaded on backend boot. The local profile uses these records as a lightweight registration boundary. They are never authentication. The networked profile authenticates human sessions and Runner service credentials separately.

id.description: Stable, immutable, kebab-case slug. Assigned by the API on first registration. Once written, never re-keyed; soft-delete sets kind=retired but preserves id so historical task attribution stays valid.

displayName.description: Free-form human-readable name, e.g. "Robert's Workshop" or "Layer 3 Review". Re-registering the same displayName is idempotent (returns the existing id).

emoji.description: Single grapheme cluster used as a visual marker on cards and chips, e.g. "🦊". Optional. Validated as a non-empty short string; the frontend renders whatever is supplied.

colour.description: CSS hex colour applied to the chip background. Optional. The frontend falls back to a neutral default when omitted.

kind.description: What kind of caller this identity represents. Soft-delete flips kind to "retired"; the record stays so historical attribution remains resolvable.

registeredAt.description: UTC timestamp the identity was first registered. Immutable.

lastSeenAt.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent request bearing this clientId. Updated on every authenticated read or write.

tokenBudgetMonthly.description: Optional monthly token cap. The API rejects mutations from this client once the rolling 30-day token total exceeds this value. Null disables the cap.

notes.description: Free-form operator notes ("shared dev box", "Layer 3 review on stable", etc.).

runnerGitStatus.description: Latest remote-daemon startup push proof. A read-only runner is refused claims; ready-no-workflow-scope remains claimable but cannot publish changes under .github/workflows.

runnerGitDetail.description: Operator-facing result of the latest contents and workflow Git push probes.

runnerGitCheckedAt.description: UTC time of the latest remote-daemon Git push capability probe.

runnerProjectPreflights.description: Cached per-project delivery proofs for this host. A repository registration change invalidates the matching entry before another claim.
